svg.title: CEO of Agents app icon, 16 px
svg.desc: Pixel-fitted form of the app icon for the 16 x 16 px export only (icon_16x16.png). 32 px and up stay rendered from the master, icon.svg. Same parts as the master, none added or removed: violet node (you), connector stem, teal node (chief of staff), three connector branches, three teal commit rings with ink centres on the teal hq line. Changes for 16 px: every part snapped to whole pixels on a vertical axis at x 7.5; nodes and rings 3 px; strokes 1 px; the three branches drawn as one 1 px row (row 9, columns 3-11) that ends straight above each ring's top-centre pixel (the master's curves run mostly sideways and are under 0.4 px wide at this size); the master's rim (0.1 px here), drop shadow (0.2 px) and line tails (0.4 px) are dropped because they cannot be drawn at 16 px. Body 13 x 13 px at (1, 1), radius 3, the master's surface-into-ink fade. Colours: ink, surface, connector, teal, violet only . Render at exactly 16 x 16, never downsampled from a larger size.
